title: Phase: Bootstrap pt SDK+CLI on Beads
description: Implement the Go module and CLI described in README: stateless pkg/pt with plan/sync/ready/validate/claim/release/reject + cmd/pt user flow. Includes manifest parsing, template-driven task creation, state machine enforcement, and ready queue.

title: Define pt schema, templates, and manifest parsing
description: Implement pkg/pt types and manifest loader per README. Include validation for required fields (title, role, deps, DoD hooks) and template params. Return rich errors for missing deps/DoD.
acceptance_criteria: Schema types cover Phase/Task/Template/DoD; templates include backend_endpoint, frontend_component, migration, bug_fix, refactor, observability_hook; manifest parser validates deps/roles/DoD and returns actionable errors; unit tests cover happy+error paths.

title: Implement Sync and Ready primitives against bd
description: Use pkg/pt to call bd (CLI or API) to apply manifest graph and list ready work. Ensure idempotent sync, correct dependency wiring, and ready filtering by role/status.
acceptance_criteria: Sync creates/updates issues and deps idempotently; ready query returns only unblocked tasks by role; includes tests for idempotent writes and cross-phase deps; go test ./... passes.

title: Implement validation hooks and rejection loop
description: Add validation hook runner plus manual confirmation. Support rejection path (needs_review -> in_progress) and ensure DoD enforced.
acceptance_criteria: pt validate runs configured commands (go test ./..., optional -race) and surfaces output; manual check prompt required when manual text present; failures keep status in_progress; reject returns to in_progress with comment; tests cover pass/fail/reject flows.

title: Build CLI commands for sync/ready/claim/validate/approve/reject/release
description: Wire CLI to pkg/pt primitives. Provide interactive prompts for missing manifest fields and clear stdout/stderr UX.
acceptance_criteria: cmd/pt exposes sync, ready (role filter), claim, release, validate, approve, reject; prompts for missing schema fields; commands return non-zero on failure; help docs added; go test ./... passes.

title: Add manifest examples and template registry
description: Populate phases/ with TOML examples and ensure templates are discoverable/validated. Include hotfix/bug_fix example and observability hook.
acceptance_criteria: phases/ contains sample manifests (login flow, hotfix) matching templates; template registry includes bug_fix, refactor, observability_hook defaults; sync dry-run test covers manifest parsing; docs reference examples.

title: Add state machine and concurrency tests
description: Implement unit/integration tests in pkg/pt for state transitions, concurrent claims, and cross-phase dependency handling.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover claim conflicts, ready gating, reject loop (needs_review->in_progress), cross-phase deps, idempotent sync; go test ./... passes.

title: Document CLI usage and developer quickstart
description: Add usage docs for cmd/pt (sync/ready/claim/validate/approve/reject), installation notes, and common failure handling.
acceptance_criteria: README updated with install/run examples, ready/claim/validate walkthrough, troubleshooting for bd hooks; AGENTS references new commands; go test ./... passes.

title: Bootstrap Go module layout and tooling
description: Initialize Go module, folder structure, and entrypoint stub for CLI using stdlib (no extra deps unless approved).
acceptance_criteria: go.mod initialized with module name; directories pkg/pt and cmd/pt created; basic main wiring with cobra/flag? (no external deps unless approved) or stdlib; gofmt/goimports clean; go test ./... passes placeholder.
